=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  Expected change site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py, function test_interim_twin_first_default_is_removed_when_the_4785_sync_lands (line 399)
  Evidence of absence: The sunset test only asserts INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_AGENTS_MD_MARKER not in _flat(AGENTS_MD). That marker is "Interim until #4785 (issue #4948):" (line 315) which only covers the opening phrase of the agents.md block (line 1116). The closing sentence "The PR that makes #4785's sync live removes this default." (line 1123) is asserted present by test_operator_docs_name_the_interim_twin_first_default (line 388), but that test skips when scripts/claude_twin_sync.py exists (line 384). A partial #4785 PR that removed only the opening sentence and left the closing sentence would pass the sunset test while leaving an orphaned sentence referencing the default that no longer exists. The presence test and sunset test together form the enforcement contract; the presence test drops out when #4785 lands, leaving the sunset test with a gap. In practice the entire block is one logical unit removed together, but the test does not enforce it.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: The plan's "Rollout — Removal trigger" (docs/plans/issue-4948-protected-path-twin-first-default-plan.md:90) states the #4785 sync PR "removes the interim paragraph, the §28.C bullet, the agents.md sentence, and the sunset test's subject text; the sunset test fails that PR until it does." The lesson learned recorded in docs/implement-plan/issue-4948-protected-path-twin-first-default.md reinforces: "A sunset (removal-trigger) test must assert the absence of every interim text the plan's Rollout names, in every file that carries it (docs included), and a paired presence test must pin the same markers while the interim is live so the sunset guard cannot pass vacuously." The presence test test_operator_docs_name_the_interim_twin_first_default already asserts both the opener marker and the closing sentence in agents.md, so the closing sentence is documented interim content.
  Expected change site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py, function test_interim_twin_first_default_is_removed_when_the_4785_sync_lands, paired with a new INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_AGENTS_MD_CLOSER_MARKER constant next to the existing INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_AGENTS_MD_MARKER constant at lines 313-314.
  Evidence of absence: The agents.md block added by this PR at agents.md:1116-1123 is one paragraph of two distinct sentences. The opener sentence (lines 1116-1121) starts with "Interim until #4785 (issue #4948):" — which is the INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_AGENTS_MD_MARKER — and runs through "and a recorded answer is never overwritten." The closing sentence on line 1122 is "The PR that makes #4785's sync live removes this default." The sunset test (tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py lines 388-396, after the autofix commit f859888) asserts only INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_AGENTS_MD_MARKER not in _flat(AGENTS_MD); it makes no assertion about the closing sentence "The PR that makes #4785's sync live removes this default." The same gap does not apply to the command twin, CLAUDE.md, or master-session.md, where the added interim text is a single logical block whose only opener carries the marker. A #4785 PR that removes the opener sentence (which carries INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_AGENTS_MD_MARKER) and leaves the closing sentence on line 1122 would pass the sunset test while leaving an orphaned sentence that references a default that no longer exists, exactly the vacuous-pass failure mode the lesson learned was added to prevent. The previous autofix commit "[claude-autofix] review round 1: sunset test covers the agents.md and master-session.md interim text" added agents.md to the sunset test but missed the closing sentence; the lesson line in the progress log (added in the same commit) explicitly warns against this exact pattern.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: The PR description "Tests in tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py" checklist enumerates every test the PR ships, and the progress log at docs/implement-plan/issue-4948-protected-path-twin-first-default.md Phase 1 sub-item 4 mirrors the count with the same completeness expectation.
  Expected change site: PR description "Tests in tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py" bullet list (5 tests → 6); progress log Phase 1 sub-item 4 text "5 new tests (command twin, CLAUDE.md, sunset guard)" at docs/implement-plan/issue-4948-protected-path-twin-first-default.md:24.
  Evidence of absence: The PR description bullet list names exactly five tests by symbol — test_protected_path_phase_records_the_automatic_twin_first_approval, test_twin_first_edits_twins_only_and_reaches_the_twin_sync_blocker, test_protected_path_question_remains_for_what_twin_first_cannot_cover, test_claude_md_section_28c_names_the_interim_twin_first_default, test_interim_twin_first_default_is_removed_when_the_4785_sync_lands. The test file tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py contains six test functions; the sixth, test_operator_docs_name_the_interim_twin_first_default (added by the autofix commit f859888185f245c72e20b32c56c534e439c8935a at lines 389-396), is not enumerated in either the PR description checklist or the progress log. The progress log's Phase 1 sub-item 4 was also updated by the same commit and still reads "5 new tests". The PR description's "Checklist evidence" section therefore understates shipped test coverage by one test (the presence test that pairs with the sunset guard).
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- Requirement: "the sunset test fails until it does" (PR description: "test_interim_twin_first_default_is_removed_when_the_4785_sync_lands, a sunset check that I confirmed fails when scripts/claude_twin_sync.py exists"). The plan's AD-4 records the sunset test as the enforcement vehicle that "makes removal happen without anyone remembering."
  Expected change site: tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py, function test_interim_twin_first_default_is_removed_when_the_4785_sync_lands (lines 388-396)
  Evidence of absence: The sunset test asserts `INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_AGENTS_MD_MARKER not in _flat(AGENTS_MD)`, but the agents.md block at agents.md:1116-1123 also contains the closing sentence "The PR that makes #4785's sync live removes this default." The presence test `test_operator_docs_name_the_interim_twin_first_default` (lines 379-386) asserts both the opening marker and this closing sentence are present while the interim is live. A #4785 PR that removed only the first sentence of the block (which carries `INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_AGENTS_MD_MARKER`) and left the closing sentence would pass the sunset test while leaving an orphaned sentence referencing a default that no longer exists. The sunset test should also assert the closing sentence is absent, or use a broader marker that covers the entire block.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- Requirement: PR description tests checklist says "5 new tests (command twin, CLAUDE.md, sunset guard)" but the file now contains 6 tests after the autofix added `test_operator_docs_name_the_interim_twin_first_default`.

The file tests/test_implement_plan_claude_command.py now contains `test_operator_docs_name_the_interim_twin_first_default` (lines 379-386) in addition to the 5 listed. The checklist was written before the autofix commit f859888 and was not updated. This is a documentation freshness issue, not a code defect.
  SEVERITY: NIT
